title: EmbedConfig
description: Configuration for automatic embedding generation from source fields.

from.description: Field names to generate embeddings from. Typesense concatenates these fields and generates an embedding vector.

model_name.description: Name of the embedding model. Supports built-in models like ts/all-MiniLM-L12-v2 or external models via OpenAI, Google, and other providers.

api_key.description: API key for external embedding services such as OpenAI.

url.description: URL of an external embedding service endpoint.

access_token.description: Access token for embedding service authentication.

client_id.description: Client ID for OAuth-based embedding services.

client_secret.description: Client secret for OAuth-based embedding services.

project_id.description: Project ID for cloud-based embedding services.
